title: WPMS/2362/2013 of Ravinder Waliya Vs Naresh Kumar AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
 Writ Petition No. 2362 (M/S) of 2013
 Ravinder Waliya S/o Sri Raj Kumar Waliya - Petitioner
 Versus
 Naresh Kumar S/o Sri Om Prakash @ Prakash Chand
 and others - Respondents
 Sri S.K. Jain Senior Advocate along with Mr. B.S. Thind,
 Advocate for the petitioner.
 Sri P.K. Chauhan, Advocate on behalf of caveator/respondent Nos. 3 to 5.

Hon'ble B.S. Verma, J. (Oral)
 Heard Sri S.K. Jain, Senior Advocate along with Mr. B.S.
Thind, Counsel for the petitioner and Sri P.K. Chauhan, Advocate
appearing on behalf of caveator-respondent Nos. 3 to 5.
 Learned counsel for the respondent Nos. 3 to 5 has agreed that
the writ petition may be disposed of without counter version.
 By means of this petition the petitioner has sought a writ in the
nature of certiorari for quashing the impugned order dated 27-08-2013
passed by Board of Revenue Dehradun in Revision No. 113/2012-13
Madan Lal and others versus Ravinder Waliya and others, Annexure
No.12 to the writ petition.
 Learned counsel for the respondent Nos. 3 to 5 has raised
preliminary objection that the writ petition has been filed on the basis
of the power of attorney, wherein power has not been given to the
petitioner to file the writ petition.
 I have perused the power of attorney. In the power of attorney,
the petitioner has been given the powers to contest the pending suits
and also to do pairwee in suit proceedings. Writ petition is also
connected proceeding of the suit, therefore, the preliminary objection
raised by learned counsel for the respondents 3 to 5 is rejected.
 Learned Senior Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner
has contended that the respondents 3 to 5 are the defendants in the
suit filed U/S 229-B of U.P. Z.A. and L.R. Act filed by the plaintiff.
The learned Assistant Collector in the suit passed interim order dated
22-07-2013. The defendant Ravindra Waliya filed revision before the
Addl. Commissioner, who vide order dated 5-8-2013 stayed the order

2
dated 22-7-2013 passed by the Assistant Collector. Thereafter feeling
aggrieved the respondent Nos. 3 to 5, defendants filed revision No.
113/2012-2103 before the Board of Revenue and the Board of
Revenue vide impugned order dated 27-8-2013 stayed the order dated
5-8-2013 passed by the learned Additional Commissioner.
 The learned Senior Advocate has contended that the Board of
Revenue has committed a manifest error of law in not considering this
fact that the petitioner has filed caveat before it on 6-8-2013 and
without giving opportunity of hearing to the caveator and without
hearing him, passed by the impugned order on 27-8-2013.
 Apart from the above facts, it is pertinent to mention here that
the respondent Nos.3 to 5/defendants, who have filed the revision
before the Board of Revenue, do not appear to be aggrieved persons,
since they have not filed any counter-claim before the Assistant
Collector in the suit. The order dated 22-7-2013 was passed by the
Assistant Collector against the respondent Nos. 3 to 5 also, but they
have not assailed that order. In view of above facts prima facie the
Board of Revenue has committed a manifest error in not hearing the
caveator before passing the impugned order.
 Learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent Nos. 3 to 5
has also submitted that direction be given to Board of Revenue to hear
the stay application afresh after hearing the petitioner. Therefore,
without entering into the merits of the case, the caveator/petitioner is
given liberty to file his objection against the interim relief application
before the Board of Revenue within two weeks from today. The Board
of Revenue, after hearing the parties, shall decide the interim relief
application, within a month thereafter.
 With the above observation the writ petition stands allowed.
The impugned order is set aside.
 Parties are directed to appear before the Board of Revenue on
5-10-2013.
 Let a certified copy of this order may be supplied to the counsel
for the parties by tomorrow on payment of requisite fee.
